title: Book information
description: Given a book title, print: the length, the first character, the last character, and whether it contains the word 'Java'.
hints: Use .charAt(0) for the first character and .charAt(length-1) for the last one
Use .contains() to check if it contains a word
solutionExplanation: We use length() for the length, charAt(0) and charAt(length-1) for the extremes, and contains() to check for the presence of a substring.
expectedOutput:
Title: Aprendiendo Java desde Cero
Length: 27
First character: A
Last character: o
Contains 'Java': true

title: Text normalizer
description: Create a function that receives a name with extra spaces and normalizes it: no spaces at the start/end, the first letter of each word in uppercase and the rest in lowercase.
hints: Use split(" ") to split into words
solutionExplanation: We remove spaces with trim(), normalize to lowercase, split by multiple spaces with a split regex, and capitalize each word using substring(0,1).toUpperCase() concatenated with substring(1).

title: URL validator
description: Create a validator that checks whether a URL has the correct format: it must start with https://, end with .com or .org, and contain at least a domain with a dot. Build a detailed report with StringBuilder.
hints: Use startsWith() and endsWith() for the checks
Use indexOf() to find the position of the domain
Use substring() to extract specific parts
Use split("/") to count path segments
solutionExplanation: We use startsWith/endsWith for format validation, indexOf for positions, substring for extraction, split to segment the path, and StringBuilder to build the report efficiently.
expectedOutput:
=== URL Report ===
URL: https://www.ejemplo.com/java/tutoriales
HTTPS protocol: ✅ Yes
Valid extension: ✅ Yes
Domain: www.ejemplo.com
Domain format: ✅ Valid
Path segments: 2

Result: ✅ VALID URL
